name: darena-data-agent
description: Mock federated A2A partner — a clinical data agent that ingests FHIR Bundles from multiple hospital systems and federates clinical decision-support questions to TrustedRisk. Used to demo the A2A handshake + capability negotiation pattern. NOT a real product.

skills.name: Evaluate patient via TrustedRisk federation
skills.description: Take a patient summary, perform A2A handshake with the TrustedRisk agent at TRUSTEDRISK_A2A_URL, request an appropriate clinical decision-support skill, and return the structured DecisionCard. Demonstrates the A2A pattern.
examples: Evaluate this patient for safe discharge via TrustedRisk.
Federate this chart to TrustedRisk for ED triage.

federation.description: Stub federation client. Performs A2A capability discovery + tool invocation against an upstream TrustedRisk agent. The handshake records every exchanged message in an audit trail.
